title: 🌙 Bo tips his watering can on the roof... where did the water go? #bedtime #kidsstories
title_alts: 🌙 Why is Bo's sunflower still thirsty... and what cracked on the roof? #bedtime #kidsstories
🌙 Bo and the cracked watering can... one cup of water till morning? #bedtime #kidsstories
description_hook: Bo's watering can springs a leak on the rooftop, and the tap is locked till morning. One cup left, one thirsty sunflower.

characters.name: Bo
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short black curls, striped pyjamas and red rubber boots, chipped front tooth

scenes.narration: High on the roof, Bo wanted his thirsty sunflower watered tonight. He whispered, "Drip, drip, one more drip."
scenes.caption: छत पर बो अपने प्यासे सूरजमुखी को आज रात पानी पिलाना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Bo, a six-year-old boy with short black curls in striped pyjamas and red rubber boots, kneeling beside a tall drooping sunflower in a clay pot on a flat rooftop, laundry line and chimney pots behind him, last orange daylight low over the town.

scenes.narration: Bo tipped the green watering can. Two drops fell, then no more. Count them with me: one, two. The rest ran out through a crack.
scenes.caption: बो ने हरा झारा उलटा। दो बूँदें गिरीं। बाकी पानी एक दरार से बह गया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo tilting a dented green watering can over the sunflower in its clay pot on the rooftop, two drops falling from the spout while a thin stream escapes a crack near the handle and soaks his pyjama sleeve, sky deepening to blue.

scenes.narration: He ran for the tap. The handle was locked till morning. One cup of water left.
scenes.caption: वह नल तक दौड़ा। हैंडल सुबह तक बंद था। बस एक कप पानी बचा।
scenes.image_brief: Bo standing at a metal rooftop tap with a padlock through its handle, the empty green watering can lying on wet tiles beside him and one small tin cup of water at his bare feet, first stars above the chimney pots.

scenes.narration: Bo pulled off one rubber boot. He said, "Drip, drip, one more drip." Then he filled it at the sink.
scenes.caption: बो ने रबर का एक बूट उतारा और नल पर उसे पानी से भर लिया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo sitting on the kitchen floor in striped pyjamas with one bare foot, holding a red rubber boot under the running kitchen tap so water rises inside it, warm yellow light from the ceiling lamp.

scenes.narration: The boot glugged. The soil went dark, and the sunflower lifted its head. Bo grinned in one wet sock.
scenes.caption: बूट गटका। मिट्टी गीली हुई, सूरजमुखी ने सिर उठाया। बो एक गीले मोज़े में मुस्काया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo on the rooftop hugging the full red boot to his chest and pouring it into the clay pot, dark wet soil and the sunflower head lifting, one bare foot on the cool tiles, moonlight and a warm window glow behind him.

scenes.narration: Say it with Bo, softly: "Drip, drip, one more drip."
scenes.caption: बो के साथ धीरे से कहो: टप, टप, एक और टप।
scenes.image_brief: Bo lying on his side on the rooftop tiles with his cheek near the clay pot, the sunflower above him against a starry sky, one red boot standing empty beside his bare foot, soft moonlight on the wet soil.

title: 🌟 Rin claims the attic bed under the window... who else wants it? #bedtime #kidsstories
title_alts: 🌟 Why does Rin want the narrow bed under the snowy attic window? #bedtime #kidsstories
🌟 Rin and the one window bed... what will she give up for it? #bedtime #kidsstories
description_hook: Snow starts, and the attic has exactly one bed under the window. Rin gets there first, but she is not the biggest.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: seven-year-old girl, two dark braids, green flannel pyjamas, freckles across her nose

scenes.narration: In the attic, Rin wanted the bed under the window. Snow was starting. She sang, "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: अटारी में रिन को खिड़की के नीचे वाला बिस्तर चाहिये था। बर्फ़ गिरने लगी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin, a seven-year-old girl with two dark braids and green flannel pyjamas, standing in a wooden attic bedroom pointing at a low bed tucked under a round window, first snow falling outside the glass, one hanging bulb giving warm light.

scenes.narration: Rin flopped her pillow onto it, first by three steps.
scenes.caption: रिन ने तीन कदम पहले पहुँचकर अपना तकिया उस बिस्तर पर पटक दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Rin dropping a white pillow onto the bed under the round attic window, her rolled sleeping bag still under one arm, snow gathering on the glass, warm lamplight across the floorboards.

scenes.narration: Rin scooted over and patted the blanket. No use. It was too narrow for two.
scenes.caption: रिन खिसकी और कंबल थपथपाया। दो के लिये जगह बहुत कम थी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin sitting on the narrow window bed patting the blanket beside her, a taller girl with a short bob and blue pyjamas standing in the attic doorway holding a sleeping bag, snowy round window behind Rin.

scenes.narration: The taller cousin claimed the whole bed. Rin's bag went by the door. She whispered, "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: लंबी चचेरी बहन ने पूरा बिस्तर ले लिया। रिन का बिस्तर दरवाज़े के पास गया।
scenes.image_brief: The taller girl with the short bob spread across the whole window bed, Rin unrolling her sleeping bag on the floorboards by a draughty attic door, cold blue snow light at the window and one dim bulb overhead.

scenes.narration: Rin unzipped her thick red quilt. "Trade you," she said. "Quilt for the window?"
scenes.caption: रिन ने मोटी लाल रजाई खोली: बदला करें? रजाई तुम्हारी, खिड़की मेरी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin holding out a thick red quilt to the taller girl in the attic, both kneeling on the floorboards between the window bed and the door, the snowy round window glowing behind them.

scenes.narration: The cousin wrapped up warm. Rin pressed her nose to cold glass, glad. Count the flakes with me: one, two.
scenes.caption: बहन रजाई में लिपट गई। रिन ने ठंडे शीशे से नाक लगाई, खुश। बर्फ़ गिनो: एक, दो।
scenes.image_brief: The taller girl bundled in the thick red quilt on the attic floorboards, Rin kneeling on the window bed with her nose almost touching the cold glass, big snowflakes drifting past outside, warm lamplight behind her.

scenes.narration: Two beds, one snowy window. Whisper it with me: "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: दो बिस्तर, एक बर्फ़ीली खिड़की। रिन के साथ कहो: खिड़की वाली सीट, सबसे मीठी सीट।
scenes.image_brief: Rin curled on the bed under the round attic window with snowy night filling the glass and a small fogged patch by her mouth, the quilt-wrapped girl asleep on the floorboards nearby, silver snow light and one soft lamp.

title: 🌙 Aarav heard a whimper by the gate... what will settle the pup? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Aarav found a cold pup near the porch... how can he help? #bedtimestory
🌙 Aarav heard crying in the dark hall... where will the pup sleep? #bedtimestory
description_hook: Aarav wanted the whimpering stray puppy to settle down before bedtime arrived.

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: five-year-old boy, short trimmed black hair, blue dinosaur pyjamas, knitted yellow wristlet

scenes.narration: Aarav wanted the restless puppy to sleep tonight. Tap the floor with Aarav: tap, tap, tap. Soft wool over tiny paws.
scenes.caption: आरव बेचैन पिल्ले को आज रात सुलाना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short trimmed black hair, blue dinosaur pyjamas, and a knitted yellow wristlet, kneeling on a tiled kitchen floor beside a cardboard box with a small brown puppy, soft moonlight through a window

scenes.narration: Aarav rolled a rubber ball near the basket, but the pup kept whining loudly.
scenes.caption: आरव ने टोकरी के पास गेंद फेंकी, पर पिल्ला रोता रहा।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short trimmed black hair, blue dinosaur pyjamas, and a knitted yellow wristlet, rolling a red textured rubber ball toward the puppy, who sits crying with lowered ears

scenes.narration: The pup scrambled out and tipped over the ceramic water dish, wetting the floor.
scenes.caption: पिल्ला बाहर भागा और पानी का कटोरा उलट गया।
scenes.image_brief: Close ground shot of a small brown puppy stepping out of its cardboard box, accidentally kicking over a blue ceramic water saucer and spilling water across the kitchen tiles

scenes.narration: Aarav traded his fluffy wool scarf for the wet dish and tucked the puppy inside.
scenes.caption: आरव ने गीला कटोरा हटाया और पिल्ले को मफलर में लपेट दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short trimmed black hair, blue dinosaur pyjamas, and a knitted yellow wristlet, gently wrapping a thick mustard-yellow wool scarf around the shivering brown puppy inside the box

scenes.narration: Curled inside the scarf, the puppy drifted asleep beside Aarav. Whisper with Aarav: hush, little pup.
scenes.caption: मफलर में लिपटकर पिल्ला आरव के पास चुपचाप सो गया।
scenes.image_brief: The brown puppy sound asleep curled inside the yellow scarf, with Aarav sitting calmly beside the box resting his chin on his knees, night kitchen warm and dim

scenes.narration: Soft wool over tiny paws. Soft wool over tiny paws.
scenes.caption: नन्हें पंजों पर मुलायम ऊन फैला दी।
scenes.image_brief: Close-up of the puppy's front paws tucked under the soft yellow knitted edge of the scarf, tranquil midnight lighting

title: 🌙 Meera heard the balcony door rattling... what can stop the wind? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Meera stopped the shaking brass handle... what will hold it? #bedtimestory
🌙 Meera felt the midnight breeze blowing... how can she sleep? #bedtimestory
description_hook: Meera wanted the noisy balcony latch to stop rattling so she could sleep.

characters.name: Meera
characters.description: six-year-old girl, shoulder-length wavy hair, teal cloud-print pyjamas, silver stud earrings

scenes.narration: Meera wanted the balcony door to stop rattling in the midnight wind. Slide the blue wooden peg.
scenes.caption: मीरा रात की हवा में खड़कते बालकनी के दरवाज़े को रोकना चाहती थी।
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with shoulder-length wavy hair, teal cloud-print pyjamas, and silver stud earrings, standing near sheer bedroom curtains billowing in the night breeze by a wooden glass-paned balcony door

scenes.narration: Meera wedged a thick book under the brass handle, but the strong breeze pushed it open.
scenes.caption: मीरा ने हैंडल के नीचे किताब लगाई, पर हवा से दरवाज़ा खुल गया।
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with shoulder-length wavy hair, teal cloud-print pyjamas, and silver stud earrings, sliding an illustrated bedtime book beneath the brass door handle as the door vibrates

scenes.narration: The book clattered to the tiles and the latch banged twice against the metal frame.
scenes.caption: किताब फर्श पर गिर गई और कुंडी ज़ोर से टकराई।
scenes.image_brief: The heavy book lying flat on the patterned tile floor while the balcony door gapes open an inch, its brass latch tapping sharply against the outer metal frame

scenes.narration: Meera folded a damp washcloth around a wooden clothes peg and wedged it into the latch hole.
scenes.caption: मीरा ने भीगे कपड़े में लकड़ी की चिमटी लपेटी और कुंडी में फंसा दी।
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with shoulder-length wavy hair, teal cloud-print pyjamas, and silver stud earrings, pressing a small blue wooden clothespin wrapped in a folded white cloth firmly into the door frame latch slot

scenes.narration: The door stayed snug and silent, letting Meera crawl back into bed. Breathe soft with Meera: slow, deep, quiet.
scenes.caption: दरवाज़ा शांत हो गया, और मीरा वापस बिस्तर पर लेट गई।
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with shoulder-length wavy hair, teal cloud-print pyjamas, and silver stud earrings, climbing into her wooden bed, looking relieved as the curtains hang perfectly still

scenes.narration: Count the stars with Meera: one, two, three. Slide the blue wooden peg. Slide the blue wooden peg.
scenes.caption: लकड़ी की नीली चिमटी को अंदर खिसका दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Detailed shot of the blue wooden peg wrapped in white cloth resting securely in the doorframe strike plate, moonlight washing over the polished floor

title: 🌙 Rohan lost his reading light inside the tent... how will he see? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Rohan's pocket torch went completely dim... what can glow? #bedtimestory
🌙 Rohan needed to see the last story page... what can light it? #bedtimestory
description_hook: Rohan wanted to read the final page of his storybook inside his bedroom tent.

characters.name: Rohan
characters.description: five-year-old boy, short spiky black hair, red flannel pyjamas, yellow wristwatch

scenes.narration: Rohan wanted to finish his picture book under the dark tent canopy. Turn the little paper wheel.
scenes.caption: रोहन तंबू के अंदर अपनी सचित्र किताब पूरी पढ़ना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Rohan, a five-year-old boy with short spiky black hair, red flannel pyjamas, and a yellow wristwatch, sitting inside a cozy sheet tent built over his bed, holding an open picture book in the gloom

scenes.narration: Rohan held his tiny keyring light against the pages, but the beam was too narrow to read.
scenes.caption: रोहन ने छोटी टॉर्च किताब पर रखी, पर रोशनी बहुत कम थी।
scenes.image_brief: Rohan, a five-year-old boy with short spiky black hair, red flannel pyjamas, and a yellow wristwatch, pointing a miniature blue keychain LED directly onto a page, producing only a tiny white circle

scenes.narration: The small battery drained down, dimming the light to a faint orange dot.
scenes.caption: बैटरी ख़त्म हो गई और रोशनी सिर्फ़ एक धुंधला बिंदु बनकर रह गई।
scenes.image_brief: Close-up on the storybook page showing the tiny LED beam fading from bright white to a dull, barely visible reddish glow

scenes.narration: Rohan placed his plastic water bottle over the dim light, scattering a bright soft glow across the page.
scenes.caption: रोहन ने टॉर्च के ऊपर पानी की बोतल रखी, जिससे पूरी किताब चमक उठी।
scenes.image_brief: Rohan, a five-year-old boy with short spiky black hair, red flannel pyjamas, and a yellow wristwatch, resting a translucent ribbed water bottle directly atop the tiny keychain light, diffusing light everywhere

scenes.narration: The whole tent lit up like a glowing lantern, warming Rohan's hands. Trace the pictures with Rohan: circle, square, star.
scenes.caption: तंबू लालटेन की तरह चमक उठा, और रोहन ने पन्ना पढ़ लिया।
scenes.image_brief: The interior of the sheet tent filled with soft diffused ambient light, illuminating Rohan's smiling face as he turns the last page of his storybook

scenes.narration: Breathe out slow with Rohan: rest, rest, rest. Turn the little paper wheel. Turn the little paper wheel.
scenes.caption: कागज़ का छोटा पहिया धीरे से घुमा दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Rohan lying down on his pillow under the gentle tent glow, eyes closing comfortably with the closed book beside him

title: 🌙 Anaya could only find one fuzzy slipper... where was the other? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Anaya had one cold foot before bed... where did it hide? #bedtimestory
🌙 Anaya checked behind the wooden chest... can she find it? #bedtimestory
description_hook: Anaya needed both fuzzy slippers on her feet before settling into bed.

characters.name: Anaya
characters.description: four-year-old girl, short curly black hair in two puffs, pink patterned nightgown, white socks

scenes.narration: Anaya wanted both warm slippers on her feet before tucking into bed. Match the two yellow buttons.
scenes.caption: अनाया सोने से पहले दोनों गर्म चप्पलें पहनना चाहती थी।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya, a four-year-old girl with short curly black hair in two puffs, a pink patterned nightgown, and white socks, sitting on the edge of a small bed with one fuzzy yellow rabbit slipper on her left foot

scenes.narration: Anaya searched behind the toy chest, but she only dragged out two mismatched woolen socks.
scenes.caption: अनाया ने बक्से के पीछे देखा, पर सिर्फ़ दो पुराने मोज़े मिले।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya, a four-year-old girl with short curly black hair in two puffs, a pink patterned nightgown, and white socks, peering behind a white toy box and pulling out two gray striped wool socks

scenes.narration: A wooden building block rolled out and blocked the closet door completely shut.
scenes.caption: लकड़ी का गुटका लुढ़ककर अलमारी के दरवाज़े में अटक गया।
scenes.image_brief: A solid blue wooden triangle toy block wedged tightly beneath the bottom edge of the wooden closet door, preventing it from swinging open

scenes.narration: Anaya asked her older brother to shine his torch while she tapped the closet hinge with a spoon.
scenes.caption: अनाया ने भाई से टॉर्च दिखाने को कहा और चम्मच से दरवाज़ा खिसकाया।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya kneeling by the closet, tapping a metal spoon against the jammed frame while a flashlight beam held by an older child illuminates the floorboards

scenes.narration: The slipper popped forward onto the carpet, fitting Anaya's cold toes snugly. Sing low with Anaya: sleep, sleepy, sleep.
scenes.caption: चप्पल बाहर निकल आई और अनाया ने उसे पहन लिया।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya, a four-year-old girl with short curly black hair in two puffs, a pink patterned nightgown, and white socks, sitting on the rug happily sliding her right foot into the matching yellow bunny slipper

scenes.narration: Count the buttons with Anaya: one, two, pairs. Match the two yellow buttons. Match the two yellow buttons.
scenes.caption: दोनों पीले बटन आपस में जोड़ दिए।
scenes.image_brief: Close-up on Anaya's two yellow bunny slippers neatly parked side-by-side on the bedside rug under soft golden lamplight

title: 🌙 Dev wanted his paper sailboat safe... where can it stay dry? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Dev left his folded boat by the sill... will the raindrops hit? #bedtimestory
🌙 Dev saw wet drops splashing the glass... where can the boat hide? #bedtimestory
description_hook: Dev wanted to protect his folded paper boat from the rain leaking by the window sill.

characters.name: Dev
characters.description: five-year-old boy, straight dark fringe, navy blue starry pyjamas, yellow plaster on thumb

scenes.narration: Dev wanted his folded paper boat safe from bedtime rainwater on the sill. Rest the paper boat flat.
scenes.caption: देव खिड़की पर रखी कागज़ की नाव को बारिश से बचाना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a five-year-old boy with straight dark fringe, navy blue starry pyjamas, and a yellow plaster on his thumb, kneeling on a cushioned window seat, holding a crisp white origami sailboat near a rain-streaked window

scenes.narration: Dev covered the paper boat with a napkin, but rain seeped through the porous tissue.
scenes.caption: देव ने नाव पर नैपकिन ढका, पर पानी कागज़ के आर-पार हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a five-year-old boy with straight dark fringe, navy blue starry pyjamas, and a yellow plaster on his thumb, laying a thin white paper napkin over the boat, dark moisture spots immediately spreading across it

scenes.narration: Droplets soaked the napkin and began bending the paper boat's pointed sail down.
scenes.caption: बूंदों से नैपकिन भीग गया और नाव का तिकोना कोना मुड़ने लगा।
scenes.image_brief: Close-up of the delicate white origami boat's top sail drooping sideways under the weight of a soggy wet napkin resting on the painted sill

scenes.narration: Dev inverted a clear plastic tumbler over the boat and weighted it with an eraser.
scenes.caption: देव ने नाव पर पारदर्शी गिलास उल्टा रखा और उस पर रबर रख दी।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a five-year-old boy with straight dark fringe, navy blue starry pyjamas, and a yellow plaster on his thumb, carefully placing an upside-down clear plastic cup over the paper boat, setting a green block eraser on top

scenes.narration: The boat remained completely dry on the wooden sill as Dev smiled. Hum with Dev: mmm, mmm, mmm.
scenes.caption: नाव पूरी तरह सुरक्षित रही और देव मुस्कुराते हुए सोने चला गया।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a five-year-old boy with straight dark fringe, navy blue starry pyjamas, and a yellow plaster on his thumb, smiling in contentment as rain streaks the dark glass outside while the little boat sits dry inside the tumbler dome

scenes.narration: Tap the window glass with Dev: drip, drop, stop. Rest the paper boat flat. Rest the paper boat flat.
scenes.caption: कागज़ की नाव को सीधा टिका दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Dev peacefully asleep under a dark blue quilt in his bed, with the miniature clear dome holding the paper boat safe on the bedside table

title: 🌙 Leo lost his wooden bear under the bed... where is it hiding? #bedtimestory
title_alts: 🌙 Leo cannot reach his sleepy wooden bear... what can help? #bedtimestory
🌙 Leo dropped his little wooden bear... can he scoop it out? #bedtimestory
refrain: Two soft pats on the blue blanket.
description_hook: Leo needed his favorite wooden bear to sleep, but it slipped under the heavy chest.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: five-year-old boy, curly black hair, striped blue pyjamas, silver star sticker on his left sleeve

scenes.narration: Leo needed his wooden bear to fall asleep tonight. Tap the quilt with Leo: one, two, tap. Two soft pats on the blue blanket.
scenes.caption: लियो को आज सोने के लिए अपना लकड़ी का भालू चाहिए था।
scenes.image_brief: Leo, a five-year-old boy with curly black hair, striped blue pyjamas, and a silver star sticker on his left sleeve, sitting up in a wooden bed looking down at the carpeted floor, soft amber bedside lamp glowing, nighttime cozy atmosphere

scenes.narration: Leo reached under the heavy wooden chest, but his arm was too short.
scenes.caption: लियो ने भारी बक्से के नीचे हाथ डाला, पर हाथ छोटा पड़ गया।
scenes.image_brief: Leo, a five-year-old boy with curly black hair, striped blue pyjamas, and a silver star sticker on his left sleeve, lying on his stomach on the navy rug, stretching his right arm into the dark gap under a dark oak chest

scenes.narration: The little wooden bear slid backward against the wall, stuck behind a pile of winter boots.
scenes.caption: लकड़ी का भालू और पीछे खिसक कर जूतों के पीछे अटक गया।
scenes.image_brief: Close ground-level shot looking into the shadowy recess under the oak chest, showing a small carved wooden bear wedged against the baseboard behind two muddy winter boots

scenes.narration: Leo hooked a long cardboard wrapping tube around the bear's foot and gently pulled.

characters.name: Nikhil
characters.description: five-year-old boy, wavy crop hair, navy starry sleepsuit, red watch

scenes.narration: Nikhil wanted ten wooden castle blocks stacked tall right on his sleeping mattress tonight. Build the tower with Nikhil: stack, rise, tall. Pack the smooth pine block.
scenes.caption: निखिल गद्दे पर लकड़ी के दस गुटके सजाकर मीनार बनाना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Nikhil, a five-year-old boy with wavy crop hair, navy starry sleepsuit, and red watch, kneeling on his low bed carefully balancing wooden building cubes

scenes.narration: Nikhil piled the heavy pine blocks near his pillow, but the tower wobbled against the duvet.
scenes.caption: निखिल ने गुटके रखे, पर रज़ाई के हिलने से मीनार डगमगाने लगी।
scenes.image_brief: Nikhil, a five-year-old boy with wavy crop hair, navy starry sleepsuit, and red watch, steadying a teetering six-block wooden tower on the uneven soft quilt

scenes.narration: The tall tower collapsed across his legs, scattering hard corner blocks under his tender shins.
scenes.caption: मीनार गिर गई और सारे भारी गुटके उसके पैरों पर बिखर गए।
scenes.image_brief: Wooden toy blocks scattered across the mattress surface and pressing into the child's pajama trousers

scenes.narration: Nikhil asked his cousin if the wooden blocks could build a sleeping fort on the carpet rug instead.
scenes.caption: निखिल ने भाई से पूछा कि क्या वे कालीन पर किला बना सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Nikhil, a five-year-old boy with wavy crop hair, navy starry sleepsuit, and red watch, transferring the wooden blocks onto the braided floor carpet

scenes.narration: Nikhil stretched out comfortably on his soft cot, free to drift off into deep sleep. Breathe quiet with Nikhil: in, out, rest.
scenes.caption: बिस्तर साफ़ होते ही निखिल आराम से गहरी नींद में सो गया।
scenes.image_brief: Nikhil, a five-year-old boy with wavy crop hair, navy starry sleepsuit, and red watch, lying completely flat on his cot with plenty of space, eyes relaxed and peaceful

scenes.narration: Pack the smooth pine block. Pack the smooth pine block.
scenes.caption: चीड़ के चिकने गुटके को डिब्बे में रख दिया।
scenes.image_brief: The wooden blocks neatly assembled into a small toy fort resting on the floor rug under gentle nightlamp illumination
